nameOfQualification: Fundamentals of Green Hydrogen Storage and Transportation
description: Individual at this job role will be responsible for development and implementation of hydrogen storage solutions for industrial, commercial, and residential customers as per the requirements. Roles shall include; detailed designing of hydrogen storage systems to maximize storage, hold time, optimized weight and capacity, maintainability, operability, distribution, cost etc. Build and test prototype storage systems together with suppliers and iterate on the design to reach the required objectives, and then develop and deploy these improvements. The individual at this Job needs to deliver Hydrogen, a highly flammable and explosive material, as compressed gas at high pressure in cascades/cylinders, or as liquid hydrogen in tanks, or as hydrogen stored in a chemical etc. to the delivery points, hydrogen refueling stations (HRS)etc.
